structured.answer: From the guide, the things worth checking for me seem to be my existing קרן השתלמות, a קופת גמל להשקעה (you can withdraw any time), or a self-run investment account, with something like the S&P 500 inside. But the page doesn't say which is better, what it costs, or what to do first.

stuck.why: Scroll jumped past the card titles; only saw the last lines of text, so I don't know which products those were
Card titles cut off again; only fragments like 'בית השקעות... קונים, מוכרים ומחזיקים מניות'. This is the part most relevant to me and I missed it
Lots of similar cards (MSCI World, AC World, S&P, Nasdaq, TA-35/90/125) with no hint which one suits me

used: Heading 'מדריך' and subtitle 'כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה'
'חיסכון עם הטבת מס' cards: קרן השתלמות, קופת גמל להשקעה ('אפשר למשוך בכל עת')
'במה הכסף מושקע' heading and S&P 500 card
skimmed: מזומן שקלי / קרן כספית / מק"מ cards
אגרות חוב ממשלתיות, מסלול כללי cards
skipped: Footer links and small grey line at bottom
Small grey line 'בכל עמוד של מוצר יש שורה...'
not_found: Any recommendation or 'start here if you're like me' for someone with 30,000 ₪ in the bank
What the first practical step is
Returns or example of how money would grow

findings.what: No guidance on which option fits a young saver with cash in the bank. The 'מאיפה להתחיל' links don't cover 'I have savings, want to invest'
Self-chosen investment account cards are hard to catch; titles easily missed while scrolling
No fees or costs anywhere on the guide
Too many look-alike index cards; no way to tell which matters
Jargon in card texts (מק"מ, אג"ח, מנוטרלת) without plain explanation
